description: This Java class defines a database migration for an Android application, specifically migrating widget preferences from SharedPreferences to a database table during app version upgrade from 15 to 16. It creates a new table, reads existing widget preferences, migrates data into the new table, and cleans up old preferences.

classes.name: Migration_15_16
classes.description: A class extending Room's Migration to handle database schema and data migration from version 15 to 16, specifically migrating widget preferences from SharedPreferences to a dedicated database table.

methods.name: Migration_15_16
methods.description: Constructor initializing the migration with context and version range.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration: creates new table, reads old preferences, migrates data, and cleans up old preferences.
